instructions: For each independent request, select the single best router and minimal workflow set from this catalog. Use null and [] if none applies. Do not perform the request. Return an object with dataset_revision, catalog_revision, and selections; each selection has exactly id, router, workflows. Copy both revisions. Include each opaque case ID once. Use only this input; do not inspect expected answers or other repository files.

cases.prompt: Before writing code, trace the existing checkout and give me an implementation plan for adding account-level usage limits.
The feature requirements are approved. Split the work into small ordered tickets with dependencies, acceptance criteria, and verification.
Turn this product brief into a technical specification with behavior, interfaces, failure cases, rollout, and acceptance criteria. Do not implement it.
Review this pull request for correctness, regressions, missing tests, and scope. Report findings only; do not modify code.
Assess this authentication and authorization design for exploitable vulnerabilities, trust-boundary mistakes, and tenant-isolation failures.
Audit the checkout flow for keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, contrast, and reduced-motion barriers. Give actionable findings with the affected journey.
Design a risk-based test strategy for migrating billing providers, including the most effective test seams and release checks.
Test this staging payments API against its contract, including invalid inputs, authorization, retries, pagination, and side effects.
Open the local application at localhost, reproduce the save failure, inspect browser and network evidence, and report the defect without changing code.
The integration-test job began failing on this branch. Find the first actionable error, determine whether it is flaky or a code defect, and propose a verified fix.
Create a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the repository's build, tests, and security checks on pull requests with least-privilege permissions.
Define the information hierarchy, interaction behavior, responsive layout, and visual direction for a new analytics dashboard before implementation.
Implement this approved checkout-page design in the existing React application, including responsive states, validation, accessibility, and browser verification.
Evaluate our RAG system by separating retrieval quality, context quality, answer grounding, citation support, latency, and cost.
Design a representative dataset and scoring rubric to measure whether our support agent follows policy, uses tools correctly, and regresses after prompt changes.
Analyze this customer-retention CSV, document cleaning decisions, check the data grain, identify trends and uncertainty, and deliver a reproducible summary.
Write a read-only PostgreSQL query for monthly active accounts, handling event grain, duplicate events, time zones, and validation totals.
Implement the account lockout rule test-first. Show each failing test, make the smallest change to pass it, then refactor while green.
Before designing APIs or tables, model the insurance-claim domain. Clarify policy, claim, case, lifecycle transitions, invariants, ownership boundaries, and ambiguous terminology.
Production checkout is failing for most customers. Coordinate mitigation, diagnosis, recovery, communication, and follow-up while preserving an incident timeline.
Capture the exact state of this unfinished migration so another AI agent can continue tomorrow without reconstructing the investigation.
Add structured logs, request metrics, distributed traces, an availability SLO, and actionable alerts to this service. Verify that operators can diagnose a failed request end to end.
Audit this repository's direct and transitive dependencies for known advisories, abandoned packages, incompatible licenses, stale versions, and supply-chain risk. Do not upgrade anything yet.

Audit this Agent Skills catalog for invalid metadata, broken references, unsafe instructions, overlapping activation, unclear provenance, and maintenance risks. Report findings without editing the catalog.
Create a shared design system for our three web products with tokens, themes, accessible primitives, component APIs, documentation, and a controlled migration path.
Build an MCP server that exposes our ticketing service through narrow tools and resources with validated schemas, least privilege, useful errors, and integration tests.
Containerize this existing API with a secure multi-stage Dockerfile, non-root runtime, health check, runtime configuration, and a local Compose setup.

Users intermittently lose draft changes. Reproduce the failure, gather evidence, rank hypotheses, isolate the cause, implement the smallest justified fix, and verify the original failure no longer occurs.

Design the tools an account-support agent needs. Define narrow responsibilities, input and output schemas, permissions, idempotency, errors, and how destructive actions require confirmation. Do not implement a server.
Design a versioned public API for subscriptions, including resources, operations, pagination, idempotency, errors, compatibility rules, and example contracts. Do not implement it.
Design a zero-downtime migration that splits the customer name column, including expand-and-contract steps, backfill, indexes, compatibility windows, verification, and rollback.
Design a daily pipeline that ingests product events, deduplicates them, enforces contracts, supports idempotent reruns and backfills, records lineage, and publishes quality metrics.

The search endpoint's p95 latency doubled. Establish a reproducible baseline, profile CPU, memory, queries, and I/O, identify the dominant bottleneck, optimize it, and compare before and after results.
Upgrade this application from framework version 4 to version 5. Inventory breaking changes, update code and configuration incrementally, verify compatibility, and define rollback steps.
Refactor this parser to remove duplication and clarify its module boundaries while preserving every observable behavior and public interface. Strengthen characterization tests first.
Prepare and publish version 3.2 with verified artifacts, migration sequencing, staged rollout, monitoring, rollback criteria, and post-release checks.
Research the current supported approaches for Python package signing. Use authoritative sources, distinguish facts from inference, cite claims, and explain uncertainty. Do not change the repository.
Resolve the merge conflicts between these branches by reconstructing both sides' intent, preserving compatible behavior, and running focused integration tests before completing the merge.
Test this CLI across valid and invalid arguments, stdin and stdout behavior, exit codes, environment variables, filesystem effects, signals, and interactive prompts.
Triage these incoming bug reports: find duplicates, reproduce credible failures, separate support questions, assign severity and priority, and produce actionable issues with acceptance criteria.
Write an operator runbook for rotating signing keys, including prerequisites, exact steps, verification, rollback, troubleshooting, and ownership. Validate every command against the repository.
Good morning!
Rewrite this sentence in plain English: The building security guard reviews visitor badges at reception.
Suggest a short title for my personal photo album about a train journey through the Alps.
Checkout errors are rising in production after the last deploy. Coordinate immediate mitigation and rollback while preserving evidence for later root-cause analysis.
Yesterday's change made the existing Linux CI job fail only on pull requests from forks. Identify the failing step from logs and fix the regression without redesigning the workflow.
My feature branch stopped halfway through a rebase onto main. Resolve the remaining conflicts and finish the rebase; keep my untracked notes out of the commits.
Finish the cherry-pick of the fix. Git reports a modify/delete conflict, but I cannot find conflict markers. Preserve the fix's behavior and the intended file removal.
In one sentence, what is the difference between a Git merge and a rebase? Do not inspect or change a repository.

Our assistant answers correctly when given the right document, but search retrieves outdated or irrelevant passages. Measure retrieval recall and freshness against labeled queries before changing prompts.
Design the HTTP contract for creating an order when a timeout may occur after it is saved. Specify duplicate submissions and stale concurrent edits; do not implement or test a running service.
Upgrade this framework and its plugin to the requested supported versions. Verify peer/runtime constraints and clean installation while preserving unrelated dependencies.
Sales and support both say customer but mean different things. Model their language, ownership, and translation without designing database tables.
Design a settings screen consistent with the supplied product patterns and brand. Specify hierarchy, responsive states, and copy; do not implement or create a new component library.
Review this login and six-digit verification flow for WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility barriers, including password-manager support and pasting the full code. Report findings only.
Exercise the local app's save flow. It failed once and passed on retry; preserve both attempts and diagnose whether this is readiness, shared setup, or product behavior. Do not fix code.
Design a GitHub Actions pipeline where optional path-specific jobs can be skipped, real failures still block merging, and merge queue checks run.
Containerize our Linux API with a working graceful shutdown, private build dependency access, and appropriate Kubernetes startup/readiness/liveness behavior.
Add fleet latency metrics and low-volume availability alerts; account for retries, sampled traces, and missing telemetry.
Design a Kafka-to-database pipeline that can replay after a crash between its database commit and offset commit, including a concurrent historical backfill.
Analyze this orders dataset enriched with customer history; verify why totals doubled and compare overall versus average-customer conversion rates.
Improve our API's p99 under the same request arrival rate; our fixed-client benchmark sends fewer requests when the service slows down.
Resume the authorized multi-platform release after the upload timed out; inspect existing version artifacts and avoid rebuilding or republishing completed uploads.
Audit these lockfiles and scanner results. A development dependency has unknown reachability; assess build exposure without installing fixes.
Our queue test fails only after the account suite. Isolate the state leak and fix it.
We have 95% coverage but our mocked billing tests missed duplicate charges. Propose a better test strategy.
This GitHub Actions run fails although its branch SHA passes locally. Diagnose the checkout and the first error.
Review all local changes, including new files, and report introduced regressions without editing them.
Review whether queued exports and cached downloads can leak another tenant's data.
Test our create-order endpoint when the response disappears after commit; verify one charge after retry.
Test the installed CLI outside its checkout, with piped output and stdin closed.
Implement and test cancellation and client capability negotiation in this MCP server.
Design a tool contract that prevents an agent's old price preview from authorizing a changed purchase.
Compare two chunkers fairly when chunk IDs changed, while keeping tenant violations separate from recall.
